name: Semantic Obfuscation of Additive Bounds
description: Replaced explicit summation formulas (`p1 + p2 > T` and `sum > T`) with equivalent scheduling logic constraints (e.g., remaining time window `T - p1 < p2` and continuous-operation minimum time). Removed the explicit mathematical summaries from the Output section to force models to derive the required checks from the physical constraints rather than pattern-matching formulas.
